title: autopilot.request.json of a project
description: A request to the running autopilot controller (<runs root>/autopilot.request.json), written atomically by `orch conduct autopilot pause|resume|drain|stop`; the controller reads and removes it at every step of its loop and at every poll.

by.description: Who asked (the user of the shell).

action.description: pause (take no new work), resume (take work again), drain (finish the current run, then stop) or stop (interrupt the current run, then stop).
